label: lem:piece-a-specht-character-trace
title: Trace of the central element $C_2 = \sum_i L_i^2$ on $S^\mu$ and on the regular representation
html:
Let C_2 = \sum_{i} L_i^2 be the sum of the squared Jucys–Murphy elements, a central element of \mathbb{C}[S_n]. Then on the irreducible Specht module S^\mu,

  \mathrm{Tr}\bigl(C_2 |_{S^\mu}\bigr)
  \;=\;
  \dim\bigl(S^\mu\bigr) \cdot \sum_{\square \in \mu} c(\square)^2 ,

and on the full regular representation of S_n,

  \mathrm{Tr}(C_2)
  \;=\;
  \sum_{\mu \vdash n}
    \Bigl( \sum_{\square \in \mu} c(\square)^2 \Bigr)
    \dim\bigl(S^\mu\bigr)^2 .
heading: Lemma
